stem: Why should sanitation records include what was cleaned, when, by whom, and which procedure or product was used?
choices: So the record can support traceability and verify that required sanitation work was completed
So workers can avoid cleaning the same area again for the rest of the crop cycle
So chemical labels can be discarded after use
So scouting can be stopped once cleaning is documented
rationale: Complete sanitation records support accountability, traceability, verification, and investigation when problems occur.
